name: evidence-medical-platform
description: SALUS — The evidence behind every path to healing.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/domain && npm-run-all --parallel dev:web dev:api
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/domain && npm run build -w services/api && npm run build -w services/ingestion && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/domain && npm run test -w services/api && npm run test -w services/ingestion && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w packages/domain && npm run lint -w services/api && npm run lint -w services/ingestion && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.docs:pdf: npm run docs:pdf:academic && npm run docs:pdf:executive
scripts.docs:pdf:academic: pandoc docs/CALCULUS_MATH_SPEC.md --standalone --mathml --css docs/pdf-print-academic.css -o docs/CALCULUS_MATH_SPEC.academic.html && npx --yes md-to-pdf docs/CALCULUS_MATH_SPEC.academic.html --page-media-type print --pdf-options '{"format":"A4","printBackground":true}' && mv -f docs/CALCULUS_MATH_SPEC.academic.pdf docs/CALCULUS_MATH_SPEC.pdf && rm -f docs/CALCULUS_MATH_SPEC.academic.html
scripts.docs:pdf:executive: pandoc docs/CALCULUS_MATH_SPEC.md --standalone --mathml --css docs/pdf-print-executive.css -o docs/CALCULUS_MATH_SPEC.executive.html && npx --yes md-to-pdf docs/CALCULUS_MATH_SPEC.executive.html --page-media-type print --pdf-options '{"format":"A4","printBackground":true}' && rm -f docs/CALCULUS_MATH_SPEC.executive.html
